name: Misa
message: 「What's the big idea, calling us in the middle of Student Council duties?」

name: Ria
message: 「Actually, we just got a report from a student that a demon was spotted on campus」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It was big and black! Floating all fluffy-like and going 'eee-eee-eee'!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it's time for the Crusaders to step in, then!」
Splitting into two groups, we patrol the campus.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm starting to get sleepy, so why don't we call it a day around here?」

name: Misa
message: 「Where did all that enthusiasm from a minute ago go?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, she did work hard on her secretary duties today, too」

name: Misa
message: 「That's one thing and this is another--both of them are important」

name: Synn
message: 「When you put it like that, you're completely right, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Though I suppose I should say, 'Big Sister is completely right'」

name: Synn
message: 「What, so you're just parroting her too, Misa?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's fine if we just let it go like that」

name: Synn
message: 「It didn't look like it was doing anything bad...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure it was just sleeping and got startled awake by your loud voice, Misa」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, as the President says, a merciful heart may also be necessary」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, having a demon on the academy grounds is already a big enough problem, isn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「If we leave it alone, there's no telling when the students might be put in danger」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then we have no choice but to punish it! Let's go!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How far are we going to chase it?」

name: Misa
message: 「How should I know! Go ask it yourself!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, if that's the case, isn't that convenient?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-President, Vice President, you both run so fast~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, the Demon is flying, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「It can't be helped. Sakura-kun and I will chase after them from here」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, Sakura-kun!? What are you doing, are you alright?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nngh, geez, Big Brother! What are you doing in a place like this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, well, a lot's going on...... What about you, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm on my way back from my part-time job」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wait a second, you guys were bullying a Demon again, weren't you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun, pull yourself together! You're the Student Council President, aren't you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「R~eally, I can't believe the Student Council President broke his promise」

name: Misa
message: 「I must admit there are somewhat problematic aspects to Sakura-kun's qualifications as Student Council President」

name: Misa
message: 「Macaron-san, you actually understand things quite well」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun really ought to taste a setback for once」

name: Macaron
message: 「Inciting Demon bullying is totally unforgivable, right!」
What is with this hostile atmosphere.

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, you're such a hopeless big brother. Nihihi!」
And with the tip of a sword, no less!

name: Misa
message: 「It's been obvious for a while now, but you really are a hopeless Student Council President, Sakura-kun」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's gone! It's gone! The milk I had in my pocket!」

name: Misa
message: 「Maybe you dropped it when you bumped into each other earlier...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez! This is all your fault, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, Big Brother, chase after it too!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop right there! If you don't stop, I-I'll punish you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It says they've been playing tag for a while now...」

name: Macaron
message: 「And since nobody was catching it, it decided to pull a prank...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so it just thought we were playing.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You weren't bullying that kid after all...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe. No good, a great Demon Lord shouldn't be jumping to conclusions like that」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nothing, really. Just thinking you're not all that impressive either, Big Brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, hurry up, or it's gonna get away!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, give Macaron back her milk」

name: Macaron
message: 「You drank it all while running away...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Grrr! Drinking the great Macaron's milk without permission!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Listen up! You know, even with pranks, there are ones that are okay to pull and ones that aren't, okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Uh, well... like putting ice down someone's back, or giving them a jack-in-the-box」

name: Synn
message: 「So stuff like that is okay, huh」

name: Macaron
message: 「See, nothing goes missing or anything, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Plus, if you say you're sorry, they'll forgive you...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wha--!? No, no! I've never done it! Something so childish!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, so even Macaron has a surprising side」

name: Macaron
message: 「Anyway! You mustn't do things that bother other people, got it?」
I'd really prefer it if they played somewhere less conspicuous, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Though chasing after them might've been a waste of effort」

name: Macaron
message: 「Awh... I wonder if I still don't have enough charisma...」
Worrying about things like that is the same for both humans and Demons.

name: Synn
message: 「You can have it. I still have plenty left for today」

name: Macaron
message: 「It'd be rude to your kindness if I held back, so I'll gladly accept it for you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Looks like... I owe you another favor, big brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I don't settle these things properly, I won't be able to save face as the Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, but this and bullying demons are two completely separate things, got it!」
Come to think of it, where does Macaron even live?
Maybe I'll ask her next time.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bring it on! Where'd the demons go?!」
Peace really is better than fighting, isn't it.
